verdict.rationale: Bevy's game logic is plain Rust, and nothing in the evidence shows a Bevy-provided language server or typed API definition files that an agent's editor can attach to for completions, diagnostics, and navigation. The reference documentation is human-facing docs, not editor tooling. Any Rust-language tooling would belong to the host language, not to Bevy itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the scripting language has first-class machine tooling — an official language server (LSP) or typed API definitions a coding agent's editor can attach to for completions, diagnostics, and navigation
